findings.title: Push events can still scan every file
findings.body: Push events still fall back to pre-commit --all-files when github.event.before is missing. That can fail on files the push did not change.

findings.title: A missing merge-group base fails the job
findings.body: The merge-group path exits 1 when merge_group.base_sha is not in the checkout. The workflow checks out with fetch-depth 0.

findings.title: Merge-group hooks no longer scan untouched files
findings.body: The merge-group job checks base_sha through head. Repository-wide hook drift on untouched files is not exercised there.

findings.title: A missing base and a hook failure share one job
findings.body: Exit 1 on a missing base commit uses the same check name as a hook failure.

findings.title: A multi-pull-request group checks the combined range
findings.body: When a merge group contains more than one pull request, the range includes the group's combined diff.
